game.reversal_rule: a move straight back into the neck is ignored

bot.moves_offered: the three legal moves (never the reversal), shuffled each move
bot.late_answer_rule: if the snake has moved before Jev answers, or the answer arrives less than 40 ms before the next move, the answer is dropped and the snake carries on straight

jev.instructions: This grid shows a game of snake, 40 columns across by 20 rows down. Reading the grid: H marks the head, N the neck directly behind it, B the rest of the body, T the last segment, F the food, and a dot a free square. On every step the head advances one square in the chosen direction and the other segments trail behind it. Steering off the grid or onto the body ends the game. Reversing is impossible: a command pointing back at N does nothing and the snake continues ahead. Swallowing the food adds one square of length. Pick the next direction: survive and reach the food.

option_descriptions.Up: Head goes one square up, to the row above.
option_descriptions.Down: Head goes one square down, to the row below.
option_descriptions.Left: Head goes one square left, to the column on its left.
option_descriptions.Right: Head goes one square right, to the column on its right.

jev.board_symbols: H head, N neck, B body, T tail, F food, . empty
